requirements.label: English proficiency for undergraduate entry
requirements.details: Present GCE O-level English Language at C6 or higher, IELTS 6.0, TOEFL paper-based 550, TOEFL internet-based 80, or an equivalent qualification.

requirements.label: How UTB counts GCE A-level points
requirements.details: Use the UTB scale for the subjects specified by the degree. A* earns 140 points, A earns 120, B earns 100, C earns 80, D earns 60 and E earns 40.

requirements.label: Applicants based in Brunei · applications and paper documents
requirements.details: If based in Brunei and applying outside the in-service route, apply through HECAS and Apply@UTB. Deliver the paper HECAS form, identity card copy and certified academic certificates with the other required documents to UTB within one week after HECAS closes.

requirements.label: Accepting an offer · payment and receipt
requirements.details: Students outside the government scholarship scheme pay a non-refundable BND 100 acceptance fee. On accepting an offer, pay applicable fees through the university Finance Office and present the official receipt at registration.

requirements.label: Three A levels · 240 UTB points
requirements.details: Obtain at least 240 UTB points from three GCE A-level passes. These must include Mathematics at grade C or above and two eligible subjects.

requirements.label: Three A levels · 280 UTB points
requirements.details: Obtain at least 280 UTB points from three GCE A-level passes. These must include Mathematics at grade C or above and two eligible subjects.

requirements.label: Civil engineering · eligible A-level subjects
requirements.details: The two other subjects may be Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Further Mathematics, Design and Technology, Computer Science or Geography. Accounting, Economics, Information Technology and Psychology also qualify if you hold a credit in GCE O-level Physics.

requirements.label: Three A levels · 220 UTB points
requirements.details: Obtain at least 220 UTB points from three passes. Earn at least C in Physics and in either Mathematics or Further Mathematics. The third subject can be Chemistry, Biology, Design and Technology, Computer Science, Thinking Skills, Accounting or Geography.

requirements.label: Two A levels · 180 UTB points
requirements.details: Alternatively, obtain at least 180 UTB points from Physics plus Mathematics or Further Mathematics, with grade C or higher in both.

requirements.label: Three A levels · 240 UTB points
requirements.details: Obtain at least 240 points from three passes, including Physics and Mathematics or Further Mathematics at C or higher in each. The third subject can be Design and Technology, Chemistry, Biology or Computer Science.

requirements.label: Two A levels · Chemistry prerequisite
requirements.details: Alternatively, obtain at least 180 points in Mathematics and Physics with both at C or above. This route also requires a credit in O-level Chemistry or equivalent.

requirements.label: Three A levels · 240 UTB points
requirements.details: Obtain at least 240 points from three passes, including Chemistry and Mathematics or Further Mathematics at C or higher in each. For the third subject, choose Biology, Computer Science, Design and Technology, Geography or Physics.

requirements.label: Three A levels · 240 UTB points and three C grades
requirements.details: Obtain at least 240 points from three passes at C or above. Present Mathematics or Further Mathematics, Physics, and one of Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Design and Technology or Geography.

requirements.label: Technical qualifications accepted for the diploma route
requirements.details: UTB lists a Brunei Darussalam Qualifications Framework Level 5 diploma, a BTEC or BDTVEC Higher National Diploma, an Advanced Diploma or an equivalent qualification. The programme applies its own grades and analytical-module requirements.

requirements.label: Diploma route · cumulative and module grades
requirements.details: On the diploma route earn a CGPA of at least 1.6 on a 3-point scale, with Merit or above in at least 60% of analytical modules.

requirements.label: Diploma route · cumulative and module grades
requirements.details: On the diploma route earn a CGPA of at least 1.7 on a 3-point scale, with Merit or above in at least 70% of analytical modules.

requirements.label: Diploma subjects used in the assessment
requirements.details: Examples of analytical modules used to assess the diploma include mathematics, soil mechanics, hydraulics and structures.

requirements.label: Diploma subjects used in the assessment
requirements.details: Examples of analytical modules used to assess the diploma include mathematics and electrical and electronic principles.

requirements.label: Diploma subjects used in the assessment
requirements.details: Examples of analytical modules used to assess the diploma include mathematics, electrical and electronic principles, electrotechnology, mechanics and thermodynamics.

requirements.label: Diploma subjects used in the assessment
requirements.details: Examples of analytical modules used to assess the diploma include mathematics, mechanics, thermodynamics, engineering design and air conditioning.

requirements.label: Diploma subjects used in the assessment
requirements.details: Examples of analytical modules used to assess the diploma include engineering mathematics, mechanics, chemistry, chemical unit operations and chemical unit processes.

requirements.label: Diploma subjects used in the assessment
requirements.details: Examples of analytical modules used to assess the diploma include engineering mathematics, mechanics, physics and reservoir engineering.

requirements.label: IB subject eligibility · confirm with Mechanical Engineering
requirements.details: The faculty web page requires Physics, Mathematics and Chemistry at SL 5 or HL 4 each, with at least two relevant sciences or Mathematics at HL. The 2026 prospectus allows a choice of third HL subject. Both give a total of 28. Confirm with the programme if your selection satisfies only one version.

requirements.label: Government scholarship for Bruneian applicants · Malay
requirements.details: Bruneians applying for a government scholarship need GCE O-level Malay Language at C6 or higher.

requirements.label: In-service applicants · employer documentation
requirements.details: Apply through Apply@UTB. Send the hard-copy application, confidential report and service record through the head of department. Have the department head or employer certify supporting documents and arrange delivery to UTB by the Apply@UTB deadline.

requirements.label: Mature entry · age, work experience and interview
requirements.details: Be at least 21 on the date of admission, have at least three years of relevant work and complete a satisfactory interview.

requirements.label: Mature entry · English and Mathematics
requirements.details: Provide GCE O-level English C6, IGCSE English as a Second Language C, a valid IELTS score of 6.0 or TOEFL 550. O-level Mathematics C6 or equivalent is also required unless the programme grants an exemption.

requirements.label: Mature entry · university academic eligibility
requirements.details: The general mature route accepts a pass in one relevant GCE A-level subject or equivalent. An alternative is a relevant Level 4 diploma, Higher National Technical Education Certificate or equivalent recognised by the Senate. The engineering degree also sets its own conditions.

requirements.label: Mature entry · engineering qualification and experience
requirements.details: The degree asks mature applicants for a relevant BDQF Level 5 diploma or equivalent and individually assesses engineering-related work experience.

requirements.label: Individual review of equivalent preparation
requirements.details: UTB can assess other qualifications, work experience or a combination individually when the preparation is equivalent to a listed route. The degree pages allow consideration of BriTE applicants.

requirements.label: BriTE preparation · where to apply
requirements.details: Apply to Kemuda Institute, HECAS and Apply@UTB for the preparatory programme. The published engineering progression list names Civil, Electrical and Electronic, Mechatronics, Mechanical, Chemical and Energy Engineering.

requirements.label: BriTE progression · passing the core modules
requirements.details: Students take one to three core modules chosen for the subjects or grades they need, plus Introduction to Programming. Achieving at least 60% in each enrolled core module gives eligibility for first-year entry to a listed degree.

requirements.label: BriTE entry · three A levels for this pathway
requirements.details: For the preparatory route, provide CDD or 200 UTB points from three passes including Mathematics and two subjects accepted by the destination degree.

requirements.label: BriTE entry · IB Diploma and subjects
requirements.details: The preparatory route requires 24 IB Diploma points with passes in Mathematics and two relevant science subjects specified by the destination programme.

requirements.label: BriTE entry · two or three A levels
requirements.details: Three passes can qualify with DDD or 180 points, including Physics, Mathematics or Further Mathematics and a third relevant subject. Alternatively, present CC or 160 points from two passes with at least C each in Physics and Mathematics or Further Mathematics.

requirements.label: BriTE entry · IB Mathematics and Physics
requirements.details: For this preparatory route obtain 24 IB Diploma points, with passes in Mathematics, Physics and another science subject accepted by the destination programme.

requirements.label: International government-scholarship application
requirements.details: International applicants seeking a Brunei Government scholarship also apply to the Brunei Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The faculty describes the usual deadline as around mid-February. Check the call for the relevant intake.
